caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wardrobe with a natural brown color. The wardrobe has a rectangular, upright structure and consists of three tall vertical panels on the upper section, with the left and right panels each divided into two recessed sections by horizontal and vertical wooden strips. Below the panels, there are ten small central drawers arranged in two vertical columns, with each drawer featuring a round knob. Flanking either side of these central drawers are larger doors, each with a single round knob, that match the upper panel design. At the bottom of the wardrobe, there are six wide drawers, arranged in two horizontal rows of three, each drawer also equipped with matching round wooden knobs. The wardrobe is set against a plain beige background and is shaded to indicate depth and a three-dimensional form.
title: Cabinet
